# 0x22E — `unknown_22e`

DLC 2 · 10 Hz · status: **unknown**

Always `00 00` in every capture, at standstill and while riding. It may belong to equipment this base model lacks (heated grips, heated seat, semi-active suspension on the GT models).

## Layout

Bytes are numbered from 0. Multi-byte values are big-endian unless a row says otherwise. Bit 7 is the most significant bit of a byte.
